title: Entropy News: Reproducible Financial-News Entropy Estimation and Decomposition
description:
Entropy News is research software for estimating time-varying information content in financial news using rolling neural language models. It provides a strict methodological reproduction path for the entropy measure introduced by Glasserman, Mamaysky, and Qin in New News is Bad News, including the decomposition of the 12-month entropy change into ENT_NEWS and ENT_MODEL components. The implementation fixes the reported 100-dimensional GloVe input, 16-unit LSTM state, 10,000-class predictive vocabulary, monthly warm-start updating scheme, article-level entropy aggregation, and lagged-model comparison needed for the published decomposition.

The repository also contains research and engineering extensions around the strict reproduction core. These extensions are kept conceptually separate from the paper-reproduction path. The software can validate an explicit Reuters-style corpus contract, but it does not certify the provenance of proprietary Reuters data and should not be interpreted as an empirical replication unless the required source corpus is independently available and documented.
